progressExplanation: Current official-source recovery and independent legal-scope review supplied 27 defensible operating-decision changes from the resumed baseline: 17 supported and 10 excluded. The goal stays active with 21 unresolved destinations. Complete current Bahrain, Maldives, Ethiopia, Iraq, Jordan, Uganda, Guinea and Vatican sources replaced specific retrieval gaps; research attempts and unresolved legal scope do not count as completed countries. No live shipping changes.
reviewScope: Japan-origin paid personal postal factory-sealed100g steamed/rolled/dried pure Camellia sinensis sencha. No special permits, certificates, registration or advance authority notice. Ordinary customs declaration, invoice and routine arrival inspection permitted.
decisionInferenceCaveat: AG/BB/SR rely on explicitly stated combined domestic-law/international-processing interpretations. QA combines actual Customs commodity-agency allocation with the personal food-guide waiver. PF applies currently maintained postal cooked-plant-food guidance to actual steam manufacture. AF/CG/OM are independently excluded on express conservative personal-scope interpretations of food/general-import permission; agricultural classification is kept separate. BS requires aseptic AND hermetic/vacuum packaging for the published food-permit waiver; ordinary factory sealing does not establish that condition. KM/MZ/ER use operative national standards/risk provisions, while GU/BQ/KN/VC/GW apply the actual domestic processing/risk definition with manufacture/ISPM32 tea as technical facts. These are explicit general-category legal inferences. MP/TO are conservative exclusions under actual affirmative permit clauses, with contrary processing/admissibility provisions retained. MP allows oral or written authorization; mandatory advance/written permission is not asserted for every small parcel. BH/MV/DM apply domestic scope and manufacture as explicit legal-category inferences, not individualized tea rulings. ET/AE/IQ/TC exclusions are conservative interpretations of affirmative food-market or physical plant-part duties, with substantial contrary readings retained. UG combines the current agricultural risk definition with full domestic regulation7/8 ordinary-arrival conformity clearance; the exemption-letter contrary reading remains documented. The authority-issued arrival ICC is not exporter-procured certification. Maldives5kg is explicitly net weight, yielding50exact100gpackets; its current checkout cap is within that weight threshold.
currentnessCorrection: KY September2026 publication starts on1November2026, not immediately; current supported entry records a future-law transition review. BB2023 law actually commenced29May2024 and replaced2007law.
